# Steerlo Project Instructions

- Stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Keep code beginner-friendly and easy to read.
- Main sections:
  - Authentication: `/login`, `/signup`
  - Dashboard: `/dashboard`
  - Essay Brainstorm Tool: `/brainstorm`
- Use route groups under `src/app` to organize features.
- Keep components small and reusable in `src/components`.
- The `/api/brainstorm` route currently returns mock AI ideas and can be replaced with a real model later.
